summary: Endurance athlete based in Cyprus. Active in running and cycling, with an occasional swim. Uses Strava to track activities and Garmin devices for detailed performance metrics.

Only sometimes: an occasional swim in the Mediterranean or a pool, nothing regular.

philosophy: Don't wait for motivation. Motivation waits for those who are already running.
